about.title: Beyond The Code.
about.p1: I am a Web Developer with a strong interest in building digital experiences through design and technology.
about.p2: My main focus is Frontend development, especially creating website interfaces that are responsive, modern, intuitive, and centered on user experience. I regularly work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS, while continuing to broaden my Backend understanding through PHP, Laravel, and MySQL.
about.p3: To me, being a developer is not only about writing code, but also about continuous learning, experimenting, solving problems, and creating digital solutions that are genuinely useful. My long-term goal is to become a Software Engineer.
